questions.prompt: Which of these scientists won a Nobel Prize?
questions.fact: The first Nobel Prizes were given in 1901. Darwin died in 1882, and Newton almost two hundred years before that.

questions.prompt: Which of these animals live wild only in Africa?
questions.fact: A few hundred wild lions still live in India, in the Gir Forest in Gujarat.

questions.prompt: How high does a passenger jet usually cruise, in kilometres?
questions.fact: About 11 km, above most of the weather and in air thin enough to save fuel.

questions.prompt: How fast can an ostrich run, in km/h?
questions.fact: About 70 km/h, faster than any other bird on land. One stride can cover 5 m.

questions.prompt: What is the Japanese art of folding paper called?
questions.fact: Ikebana is flower arranging, and bonsai is growing tiny trees in pots.

questions.prompt: Which strait separates Spain from Morocco?
questions.hint: A famous rock stands at its northern end.
questions.fact: At its narrowest the strait is about 14 km wide, and on a clear day you can see Africa from Europe.
